Interface GatewayInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
Gateway
public interface GatewayInterface extends Remote
Remote interface for the Gateway server in a distributed system. This interface defines the methods that can be remotely invoked by client applications or other components in the system.
